summary.headline: Cummins India Q2 FY27 sales rose 4% to INR3,247 crores, but PBT fell 28.4% to INR601 crores on inflation-driven margin compression.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 4% YoY to INR3,247 crores, with domestic sales up 5% to INR2,692 crores and exports up 2% to INR555 crores. Profit before tax fell 28.4% YoY to INR601 crores and 16.6% QoQ, which management attributed mostly to commodity and input cost inflation rather than mix. Management is pursuing phased pricing actions, supplier cost work and operational efficiency, but said price realisation will lag because of the contracted order book. The call was the first under new MD Gbile Adewunmi, who took over on November 1, 2026, and management gave no forward margin or export guidance.

segments.name: Power generation (domestic)
segments.commentary: INR1,308 crores, down 2% YoY and 8% QoQ. Data center share was about 30-40% of power gen sales; within power gen, LHP was INR98 crores, mid-range INR236 crores and heavy duty INR142 crores, with the remainder data center including high horsepower.

segments.name: Distribution (domestic)
segments.commentary: INR900 crores, up 13% YoY and 2% QoQ, the fastest-growing domestic line this quarter.

segments.name: Industrial (domestic)
segments.commentary: INR406 crores, up 5% YoY but down 11% QoQ. Sub-segments: construction INR131 crores, rail INR117 crores, compressor INR54 crores, mining INR49 crores, marine INR27 crores, rest defence, oil and gas and parts.

segments.name: Exports - high horsepower
segments.commentary: INR268 crores, down 4% YoY and 10% QoQ. Export region split by share: Europe 29%, LAU 28%, Asia-Pacific 22%, Middle East 15%.

segments.name: Exports - LHP
segments.commentary: INR226 crores, up 3% YoY and 25% QoQ.

guidance_outlook: No forward-looking margin guidance; management declined to say whether the EBITDA or gross margin has bottomed.
Management expects demand across key end markets to remain resilient in the near term.
Geopolitical uncertainty, commodity and inflationary pressures are expected to persist in the near term.
Management expects solid export performance going forward but gave no specific export growth guidance.
Capex philosophy unchanged: continued investment in sustenance, growth, facilities and safety, with no major change.
Price realisation will lag cost increases because of contracted order book; pricing actions have started but will take time to reflect in revenue.
capex_capacity: QSK60-powered G34 and G37 genset solutions launched at bauma CONEXPO INDIA 2026; CPCB IV+ compliant 125 kVA genset showcased.
Data center capacity constrained partly by supplier capacity; management is working with suppliers to ramp up in a sustainable way, and gave no lead-time figures.
No major changes to QSK95 indigenisation or QSK60 capacity expansion in India; network is under constant assessment.
Cash balance cited by analyst at INR38-40 billion; management said capital allocation philosophy is unchanged.
BESS: good inquiries from shopping malls, hospitality and educational institutions; not yet material in numbers.
demand_pricing: Demand described as robust across all segments; data center demand described as stronger than expected given the AI boom, with a robust pipeline.
Pricing actions are being taken in phases but management would not quantify price hikes; price changes apply to new orders, so there is a lag because orders in hand are executed at contracted prices.
Industrial business is largely tender-based, with fixed prices on win, which limits quick pass-through.
Q2 growth shortfall attributed to data center mix, rail (coach factories holding inventory), marine (slow project execution) and compressor (supply shortages).
Management said there were no specific one-offs beyond a corporate cost allocation true-up, which sits in other expenses and was not quantified.

qa_highlights.question: What pricing actions have been taken, and will EBITDA margins bottom this quarter?
qa_highlights.answer: Management focuses on price realisation, supplier cost mitigation and operational efficiency. It declined to give forward margin guidance.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the 400 bp gross margin decline is inflation versus mix?
qa_highlights.answer: Most of the decline was inflationary commodity cost; mix was a relatively small factor.

qa_highlights.question: Is the company losing data center share given long QSK60 lead times?
qa_highlights.answer: Demand is robust globally; capacity is constrained partly at suppliers, and the company is ramping in a sustainable way. Lead times were not shared.

qa_highlights.question: What is the data center share of power gen, and how is ex-data center power gen performing?
qa_highlights.answer: Data center is 30-40% of power gen sales and fluctuates quarterly. G-Drive business is growing well; management said quarter-on-quarter is not the right way to view it.

qa_highlights.question: Why is industrial growth in single digits and what is being done?
qa_highlights.answer: Rail was softer on coach factory inventory, marine was slower on project execution, and compressor was constrained by supply. Government tender-based infrastructure work is the focus.

qa_highlights.question: Is there a risk from fuel cells or natural gas gensets to diesel gensets?
qa_highlights.answer: Diesel gensets remain the primary backup power solution in India. Alternatives depend on infrastructure, technology and cost being right.

risks_watch: Gross margin pressure from commodity inflation; pricing lag on contracted orders may persist into coming quarters.
Data center demand concentration and possible slowdown or lumpiness; no hyperscaler order timing disclosed.
Supplier capacity constraints affecting QSK60 lead times and compressor supply.
Export volatility from geopolitics; H1 exports still show marginal decline YoY.
Industrial segment growth in single digits, dependent on tender timing; rail, marine and compressor were soft in Q2.
Unquantified corporate cost allocation true-up in other expenses.
summary.management_tone: Cautious and somewhat evasive on forward numbers: management declined to give margin, export, pricing or lead-time guidance and repeatedly cited uncertainty. It was confident on demand and the data center pipeline, and framed the margin hit as an inflation-driven timing issue.
key_quotes: Most of it is inflationary pressures.
I can't provide any forward-looking statements in terms of where margins will go, but what I want to assure you is the team is working very hard to continue to improve our margins.
Demand continues to be robust in all the segments across our key end markets, and we have sustained order execution supporting year-over-year revenue growth.

financial_highlights.value: About 400 basis points (per analyst question, not disputed by management)
financial_highlights.change: Management said most of the decline was inflationary commodity cost, with a small mix effect

adds.what: QSK60-powered G34 and G37 genset solutions launched at bauma CONEXPO INDIA 2026 (product launch, not a capacity addition)

growth.why: No quantified FY27 sales guidance; management only said demand is expected to remain resilient, with no margin or export guidance, and pricing will lag because of the contracted order book. No company-owned capacity addition was disclosed beyond a product launch; data center supply is constrained by suppliers with no lead-time figures.

mgmt.note: Gbile Adewunmi took over as MD on November 1, 2026; the call gave no specific growth plan from him, only that demand is expected to remain resilient.

oneOffs.what: Unquantified corporate cost allocation true-up in other expenses (sits in other expenses, affects profit, not revenue; management said no other one-offs)

quality.why: Revenue grew 4% YoY to INR3,247 crores with domestic +5% and exports +2%, led by distribution (+13%) and offset by power gen (-2%), but the brief gives no volume or price split for the top line, and the 28.4% PBT fall is driven by roughly 400 bps of inflationary commodity cost compression rather than growth quality, so the revenue growth driver cannot be firmly classified.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Gross margin fell about 400 bp YoY on inflationary commodity costs, PBT fell 28.4% YoY, and pricing lags because orders in hand are at contracted prices; management gave no margin guidance and would not say the margin has bottomed.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: No company-owned plant, line or capacity addition was disclosed; QSK95 and QSK60 India capacity expansion is unchanged, and data center supply is constrained at suppliers with no lead-time figures.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Domestic sales grew 5% YoY to INR2,692 crores and distribution grew 13% YoY, but data center demand is lumpy (30-40% of power gen), H1 exports still show a marginal YoY decline, and rail, marine and compressor were soft.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Management says the capex philosophy is unchanged with no major change, utilisation was not disclosed, and the cash balance is cited at INR38-40 billion, so no new capex is signalled.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: No quantified FY27 sales guidance was given, management only said demand will stay resilient, and it declined to give margin or export guidance.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Commodity and inflationary pressures are expected to persist, price realisation lags cost increases on contracted orders, and Q2 PBT fell 28.4% YoY, so a margin-led cut is a risk even though management has not formally guided.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: QSK60-powered G34 and G37 genset solutions were launched and a CPCB IV+ compliant 125 kVA genset was showcased, though the BESS line is not yet material in numbers.

rows.label: Phased price hikes on new orders
rows.why: Pricing actions have started in phases and apply to new orders, but management would not quantify them, and the contracted order book means revenue impact comes later.

rows.label: Data center demand pipeline
rows.why: Management described data center demand as stronger than expected with a robust pipeline, but no hyperscaler order timing was disclosed and supplier capacity limits how fast it converts.

rows.label: Supplier cost mitigation and operational efficiency
rows.why: Management is pursuing supplier cost work and efficiency, but gave no quantified savings, and inflation is expected to persist in the near term.

tone.note: Management was confident on demand and the data center pipeline but cautious on forward numbers, declining margin, export, pricing and lead-time guidance and attributing the margin hit to inflation.
